about: Faint Southeast Asia land outline (Natural Earth 1:50m for the mainland and the Philippines; geoBoundaries gbOpen ADM0 for Malaysia and Indonesia, finer near Singapore) and the Marina Bay Street Circuit centreline (bacinger/f1-circuits, sg-2008.geojson, the layout used since 2023). Drawn behind the wall's cells. The Marina Bay water cut-out is an approximation traced from landmark coordinates (Merlion Park, The Float, Helix Bridge, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore Flyer) and the circuit's own line, because the boundary data counts the bay as land.

track.name: Marina Bay Street Circuit
track.tip: Marina Bay Street Circuit · Singapore Grand Prix, 9–11 October 2026 (race Sunday 11 October, 8 pm). 4.927 km, 19 corners, run clockwise around Marina Bay; a night race under lights since 2008. Lap record 1:33.808, Lewis Hamilton, 2025.
